classes.name: masks
classes.reason: In the measure loop the main process calls probe.read_staged on the class_a item and times it as 'gated' stall before sleeping for compute, so the reading rank stalls on that single read of each file with no overlap.

classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: class_b items are read once each by the separate _prefetch process feeding a depth-8 queue, so the reads overlap the main process's class_a work and compute sleep rather than blocking it.
